label: Household waste recycling centres
one_row_is: one recycling centre (household waste recycling centre / civic amenity site) as published by the body responsible for it

columns.name: address
columns.meaning: street address as published, one line; null if the publisher gave none

columns.name: postcode
columns.meaning: UK postcode as published, upper-cased, single space; null if absent

columns.name: lon
columns.meaning: WGS84 longitude; converted from British National Grid if the source gave eastings/northings; null if no location

columns.name: coords_source
columns.meaning: wgs84 | bng_converted | none — how lon/lat were obtained

columns.name: operator
columns.meaning: operating body or contractor if published

columns.name: opening_hours
columns.meaning: opening hours as published, verbatim; never normalised

columns.name: materials
columns.meaning: accepted materials as published, verbatim; null if not published

columns.name: status
columns.meaning: open/closed/temporary as published; null if not published

columns.name: as_of
columns.meaning: the date the source says the record is current to; null if the source states none (do not use the download date)

rules: Never invent coordinates: if the source has neither lon/lat nor eastings/northings, both stay null and coords_source is 'none'.
Opening hours and materials are verbatim text; they are not parsed into a structure by this family.
A row is one site; if a source lists one site per material or per opening day, the adapter must say so and the source is held at 'mapped' for review.
